title: I am all about owning and controlling your data as a pathway to privacy. So many interesting responses to @kaxline article https://news.ycombinator.co
summary: I am all about owning and controlling your data as a pathway to privacy. So many interesting responses to @kaxline article https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=19563278 are arguing that owning your data is inherently evil I disagree. Own your shit and do with it what you want
